$comment: Single source of truth for the water-eject tone. Read by src/lib/engine.ts and by media/video/render_tone.py. Sources: science-report.md 'Suggested evidence-based protocol' (run-pause-run pulses, Apple US10595107 'about 10 tones'; low tone 150-300 Hz stepped, not one fixed number; under 1 minute continuous per cycle).

water.frequencySteps: linear across the pulses of one cycle: pulse i uses start + (end-start) * i/(pulses-1), rounded to 1 Hz

resonancePass.$comment: Optional, off by default, labelled experimental. Micro-speaker resonance about 450-900 Hz (Knowles/AAC datasheets).

check.$comment: Before/after listening check: short exponential sweep at moderate level, then the user answers.

dryingTimer.$comment: Apple support 102643 / HT207043: wait 30 minutes to 5 hours before cable charging; up to a day if the liquid alert returns.
